title: Finding
description: A single issue reported by a scanning tool, in the verdict envelope.

tool.description: Name of the tool that produced this finding, e.g. "secretscan".

rule.description: Tool-specific identifier for the rule or check that triggered, e.g. "aws-key".

path.description: File path the finding applies to, relative to the scan root.

line.description: 1-indexed line number the finding applies to.

fingerprint.description: Stable identifier for this finding, used to dedupe the same finding across repeated runs. Derived from tool, rule, path, and line — see the README for the exact derivation. Tools may supply their own; verdict fills in a default when absent.
